_about: Single source of truth for the calibrated model. All model scripts read parameters from here; produced by calibrate.py (exactly-identified 4v4 design) against calibration/eff_targets.csv.

household._external: ra and beta_patient are set externally, not calibrated. ra = real net return on the housing-heavy illiquid portfolio; beta_patient = the patient (accumulating) type, beta*(1+ra)~1.016.

untargeted._note: MPC is not targeted; it, the poor/wealthy-HtM split, the net-wealth median and the top-1% net-wealth share are computed and reported for reference (not targeted).

household._note_precision: beta_modal is steep in the illiquid moment; stored to 8 decimals and re-pinned by --refine.

country_variable_share_stock_2022._source: Spain: EFF 2022. Euro area: ECB (2025, pure-ARM stock ~25%). Germany/Italy/France: ~2022, consistent with the ECB ordering and the HFCS cross-country ranking (Ehrmann-Ziegelmeyer, ECB WP 1631). See docs/sources.md.

notes: Steady-state mortgage payment uses the measured rate_level; spread_over_euribor_2022 is the margin over Euribor, used only in the incidence narrative.
Germany's counterfactual uses the ECB MIR / ESRB stock variable-rate share (0.12).
Household calibration is the exactly-identified 4v4 design; see household._note_precision and calib_E_4v4.py.
